comparison: Compared with control empf-v8 (11/11 required + 2/2 diagnostic Tier 1 PASS, readout-33f7628135472eef06f0d92a), t2-secant-v1 matches ring16_acquisition (43.6s vs 47.1s), two_pole, ae_gan_hold, zero_tanh_smoke, model_ae_reconstruction, model_vae_categorical, and clockfree_audit_measurement_v1 while cutting DCGAN r256 latency 1.60x vs empf-v8 (5.53x vs rhbi-v12, 44.69x vs bcap), but over-damps low-d critic gradients (two_pole grad_med 0.196 vs 0.766) via unscaled all-pairs supremum secants and under-bounds 170D isotropic InputNoise perturbations on five_word_joint_smoke due to missing sqrt(d) random-direction projection scaling.
conclusion: prediction_observed_tier1_blocked: t2-secant-v1 confirmed its pre-registered two_pole prediction (grad_med = 0.1962 <= 1.0, mean_abs = 0.9583 >= 0.30, PASS) and passed 6/11 required + 1/2 diagnostic Tier 1 discriminator_stability tasks (two_pole, ring16_acquisition 16/16 modes hq=0.9321, ae_gan_hold, zero_tanh_smoke, model_ae_reconstruction, model_vae_categorical, clockfree_audit_measurement_v1 4/4 parity) at source 8eaf48ee3e2e under protocol seed 0 without any autograd.grad/create_graph=True, but failed 5 required Tier 1 tasks (gaussian1d_smoke std_ratio=1.398, unused_token_hold passing_suffix=4/5, model_ae_gan_multimodal passing_suffix=1/5 despite 8/8 final metrics PASS, model_vae_hard likelihood_mass_tv=0.1577 vs <=0.15, five_word_joint_smoke modes=2/5) plus diagnostic precision_gaussian_fp32 (cdf_ks=0.0865), halting progression to Tier 2.

hypothesis: Pure 1st-order Variational Multi-Scale Secant Born-Infeld critic regularization (reusing live D(x_real), D(x_fake) logits plus one detached Chebyshev-Weyl transport-chord probe with all-pairs Kantorovich supremum secants on low-d manifolds and Weyl-cyclic secants on images) enforces actual 1-Lipschitz critic slope (two_pole grad_med <= 1.0) and preserves discriminator_stability Tier 1-2 gates on NVIDIA RTX A6000 under protocol seed 0 without create_graph=True double-backpropagation.
next_action: Diagnose the exact low-d secant over-damping and high-d isotropic perturbation projection in _T2SecantPenaltyKernel, then formulate and evaluate bounded candidate t2-secant-v2.

study.competing_explanation: If finite-difference secant bounds along 1D transport chords and batch-pool pairs leave orthogonal off-manifold critic directions unbounded, then replacing 2nd-order autograd.grad(create_graph=True) with 1st-order secants will allow actual Euclidean input gradient norms to blow up (two_pole grad_med > 1.0) or break multimodal/continuation gates (ring16_acquisition, gaussian1d_stability, five_word_joint_hold).
